# Junco Reader

> Junco Reader is a free browser tool that reads DRM-free EPUBs, PDFs, Markdown, and pasted text out loud.
> Junco does not upload or persist document contents. Instant uses only browser voices reported as local.
> Natural fetches model and runtime assets, then synthesizes client-side. No account required.

## Key facts
- Platform: web (any modern browser with WebAssembly support).
- Status: live, free to use.
- Categories: text to speech, EPUB reader, PDF reader, accessibility tool, in-browser AI.
- Differentiators: Instant uses only local-reported browser voices; optional Natural Kokoro TTS fetches weights then synthesizes in the page (not a cloud TTS API); no account; Junco does not upload or persist document contents; works with DRM-free EPUB/PDF/TXT/Markdown/pasted text.
- Companion product: Junco, an iOS app that turns email newsletters into a daily podcast.

## Not to be confused with
- The dark-eyed junco (a North American songbird).
- Junco Capital (a finance company).
